messages.text:
Two picks, and honestly it's between them.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at about 650W, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s. Cheapest per terahash we sell. Pre-sale, ships November 14.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450W, quiet at around 50 dB. Less hashrate, much less power. Pre-sale, ships October 30.

If power is cheap where you are, take the Magic Miner. If it's expensive or the unit lives in a bedroom, the B30.

Tell me your state or country and I'll run the actual sats and power cost for you.
